Subject: Vendor AP window / early remit request for onboarding

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks again — excited to get ClearLedger live with Redwood. Quick ask from our finance team as we complete the onboarding package: our bank cutoffs mean invoice files processed after the 15th of the month clear on the following month. To avoid a month-long lag for our first two invoices, could Redwood either:

- shift activation so initial invoices fall before the 15th cutoff, or
- allow a one-time early remit on the first invoice (we can provide ACH confirmation), or
- enroll in your early-pay program for Net30 invoices (we can accept a 1.25% fee).

We attached the onboarding form and a sample invoice to show the typical dates. If needed, happy to jump on a 20-min call this afternoon.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Finance Ops | ClearLedger

Hi Samira,

Thanks for the note and the docs — I pulled the onboarding form into our vendor queue. We typically default to Net45 for new vendor activations pending PO alignment, but we can make exceptions for launch-critical partners. Two quick clarifications that will help us pick the least disruptive path:

1) Do you have a preferred PO start date (the date you expect Redwood to appear on your remittance system)?
2) Is the early remit request limited to the first two invoices, or do you expect ongoing accelerated remits?

If it’s just the ramp invoices, we can do a one-time manual trigger from our finance ops team; if you want an ongoing early-pay program we’ll need Marcus from Finance to sign off on the terms (discount % and a billing schedule).

I can start the PO with Net30 for the first two invoices and mark the account for a pilot so we don’t permanently change the default. Looping Ben for PO/portal steps (Ben — can you confirm what info you need from Samira to lock PO dates?).

Thanks,
Mina
Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference

Samira / team,

I reviewed the onboarding form — thanks for including the remit instructions. For PO activation I need:
- vendor legal name exactly as on W9,
- taxpayer id (last 4 digits acceptable for initial PO),
- preferred PO start date, and
- bank remit instructions if they differ from the invoice footer.

If you can confirm those, I can route the PO for internal approval today. For the billing cadence: we can put an initial PO with Net30 effective 2027-05-20 so your first invoice (dated 05/26) would fall inside the net window and avoid the 6/15 processor cutoff you mentioned.

Also flag: our AR team requires the vendor agreement to include the early-pay fee in Appendix A to automate settlements. If you’re okay, upload the signed agreement and we’ll add it to the vendor record.

Thanks,
